steps.text: Why do I want to join the Armorless Union?
What a weird question. This is your organization, old man. What's there to explain?
So, does this count as my interview? I heard all the companies around town do stuff like this now. Are we going to interview every new recruit from now on? Should I start calling you 'Boss'?
Stop being such a pain in the ass.
The way I see it, there's no difference between a hitman agency and any other business. Show up to work, do some overtime, then make that someone else's problem.
If I had to give you a reason, then it's probably for the extra cash. Sure as hell beats what I make from hunting fowlbeasts.
It's the same stuff anyways—you aim, you shoot. Of course the higher paying job's gonna motivate you more.
Isn't that right, boss? After all, everyone just wants to live the good life.

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: The Armorless Union's hitmen. How did you people find this place?

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: Does that really matter at this point?

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Celebrities such as yourself naturally attract attention with their every move.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: While you've done your due diligence, good sir, how should I put this... We're hardly the only ones who can track you down.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: There are plenty of people who have it in for you. Beating them all to the punch was no small feat.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Time is of the essence. I do hope you can trust our good intentions.

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: ...Trust you?

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: The Armorless Union, speaking to me of trust? If that's a joke, I'm not laughing.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: When necessary, we are also capable of NOT being Armorless Union.

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: Hitman, is this the reason you sent your subordinates to die by my hand?

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: Are you planning to—

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Shh. Some things are better kept to yourself.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: A man as wise as you surely understands this.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Do us a little favor, and you'll earn yourself an out. It's a pretty good deal if you ask me.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: You scratch our back, we scratch yours. So how about it?
The Armorless Union's Lazurite rank. How about it? Sounds pretty powerful, doesn't it?
Honestly, the pay isn't half-bad either. In a way, it's not too different from being a competition knight. You earn your keep by putting your life on the line.
You don't get paid the big bucks without taking a few risks, right?
That said, after more than a decade in the business, it's time to hang up the hat.
'Quit while you're ahead.' The simplest truth to live by. Why swim against the current of the era? There are more stable sources of income, so why burn your life away?
Bring your ship back to port when the time's right.
How could being someone else's underling possibly feel as good as being your own boss?

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: The surgery is scheduled in two hours. Be sure to show up on time.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: Starting tomorrow, your new name will be Joel Tyrell. And in two days, the company will put in a word for us, so don't mess it up.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: Also... the General Chamber's people don't seem to completely buy that we died along with the Blood Knight. Not yet, anyway.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: Tch, the Armorless Union is already preparing to select the next Lazurites before the investigators have even left.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: In other words, lay low and spare us any unnecessary trouble until this all blows over.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: ...Hey, are you even listening?

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Huh? Oh, yes, of course.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Ma'am, I'd like to have the most expensive meal set.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: No need for a bag, I'll be eating here. Oh, and make it extra spicy, please!

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Okay, so what were you saying, Monique?

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: ...Go die in a ditch.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: What an awful thing to say. Why, if I died, poor Mrs. Tyrell would end up a widow—

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: She sure hung up fast.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: (Seems like everything's going smoothly. Even if the Board of Directors has its doubts, it's already too late. As for the Blood Knight... If he knows what's good for him, he'll keep his head down and not make a mess of things.)

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: (After all, everyone is too busy looking out for number one. Nobody will lose sleep over a couple of 'tools' going missing.)

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: (I probably don't have to worry about Darksteel either. All that's left is a face transplant and a new identity...)

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: (Guess I'll be kissing goodbye to this handsome mug then.)

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: (Who knows how I'll look when it's done, but somehow I doubt I'll be quite as gorgeous.)

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: (Alas, what a pity.)
The former Lazurite stands on the street, concealed beneath the shadows of the neon lights.
He lifts his hands to pat his cheeks while aimlessly looking out at the bright city lights.
The most recent news highlights are being broadcast on the big screen on the side of a skyscraper.
All the other screens dotting the cityscape, large and small, play roughly the same thing, their clashing noises and flashing lights enough to make one a bit dizzy.

steps.name: Television
steps.text: The Blood Knight was attacked by unknown assailants in his secluded countryside home. There were traces of an intense struggle, and it has been confirmed that the blood left at the scene belongs to the former champion himself.

steps.name: Television
steps.text: The bodies of the attackers were also found at the scene.

steps.name: Television
steps.text: Experts have commented that it is highly unlikely that the Blood Knight survived such a fierce battle, which is consistent with the large quantities of blood found.

steps.name: Television
steps.text: The leading theory at the moment is that our former champion, weakened after his battle with the Radiant Knight, exhausted the last of his strength and passed away along with his assailants.

steps.name: Television
steps.text: For more information, please stay tuned to our follow-up program! The truth behind the attack on the Blood Knight!

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: Those bastards! What 'truth'? It's all a bunch of baloney!

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: How could the Blood Knight be defeated by mere assassins? Not a chance in hell! He's probably just laying low because he doesn't want those media bloodsuckers bothering him over an injury! They only care about the next scoop!

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: And damn the whole lot of those shameless murderers! Gutter-dwelling pests! The Blood Knight would never go down like this!

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: Calm down, you can say what you want, just stop flailing your arms like— Yowch, that's my head!

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: ...Huh?

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: S-Sorry, I got a bit too worked up there. You alright?

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: Gaah... I'm fine... I guess this just isn't my lucky day.

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: Hey, you over there! Yeah, you! You didn't get hit, did you?

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: You alright, man? He didn't hit you in the head too?

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Uh... Huh? Sorry, err, were you talking to me?

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: Who else is there? There's only the three of us squatting by the food stall in the middle of the night.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Hmm, I suppose so. I appreciate the concern, but I'm fine. I was just in shock after hearing the news.

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: The news is nothing but a load of shit!

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: Those carrion-lickers only care about the scent of blood and death. They don't give a damn about whether the Blood Knight lives or dies. They don't know a goddamn thing, which is why they can run their mouths like that!

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: 'After being defeated by the Radiant Knight, the former champion yada yada!'

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Tsk tsk. As long as you pick a good clickbait title, you can easily farm a few days' worth of ad revenue. No one with a bit of curiosity can resist. It's just the latest way to make a quick buck these past two days.

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: He shouldn't be this... this token of consumerism!

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Well said. You're exactly right.

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: Our company does some business with the knight competitions. I ran into him a few times while following the project, but our holdings went down the drain as soon as the news came out.

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: *sigh*... Personally, I'm a big fan, so I hope he's alright.

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: ...Hmph. That's more than enough reason to treat you to a drink then!

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: I mean, as an apology for what just happened.

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: How about it? Or are you too scared to have a drink with an Infected?

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: But I have work tomorrow...

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: Well, whatever. I'll cross that bridge when I get to it.

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: You pick the place then.

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: Heh, I like your guts. How about you then? Wanna all go together?

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Me?

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Actually, I have some things I need to attend to soon—

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: ...Still, fate has brought us together, and kindness is hard to find these days. So, why not? Lead the way.

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: Great! Follow me!

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Pwah! Cheers!

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: Cheers!

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: ...Wrap it up, you two. I'm not made of money, you know.

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: Actually, uhh, I recognize you. You're the one who competed today, that, uhh—

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: Ironwrist Knight!

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: Wow, I can't believe I got my head smacked by Ironwrist Knight's iron wrist...

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Ahahaha! That's gotta be worth at least a point!

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: C'mon, I already apologized, didn't I?

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: Ahh!

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: Too bad about today, you almost got the win. If only the other side didn't get that supply pack!

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: I bet on you, you know!

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: ...Really? Why would you do that?

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: Because the odds were good. Why else?

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: Oh... Makes sense...

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: But just so you know, you shouldn't bet on Infected knights next time. They won't let us win.

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: I gave it my all, but still failed. I doubt the people behind the scenes are very happy with me, after my last showing.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Woah, that sounds awful.

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: If only I had the Blood Knight's skills...

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: He still lost to the Radiant Knight though. Er, sorry, shouldn't have brought that up.

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: By the way, what do YOU do?

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: Are you some sort of knight too?

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Nothing of the sort. I'm just a hunter from the sticks who occasionally stops by the big city. I usually hunt fowlbeasts, and can sometimes even turn a profit if they manage to fetch a good price.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: But it's been rough these days, so I've been thinking about how to make it big in the city.

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: Like becoming a competition knight? You can make a lot of quick cash if you manage to win.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Nah, forget it. I don't have what it takes to be a knight anyway.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: I'm no good at fighting.

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: You've got a good head on your shoulders then. The knight competitions may be glamorous, but only a small handful of us make any real money. Not the kind of thing you want to be worrying about.

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: Heck, I wouldn't be doing this either, if I had a choice.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Life has a way of messing with us all, brother.

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: You said it. Back then, all I ever thought about was how much better life would be in the big city.

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: If I could go back in time, I'd tell myself from a few years back to just forget about Kawalerielki. Should've stayed home and worked an honest job.

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: I'd rather spend my entire life farming than... doing whatever I'm doing now.

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: Agreed, only a tiny minority are able to make good money.

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: But even then, what the best paid competition knight earns is nothing compared to the real profit that the companies behind them are making... *hic*.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: You've had too much to drink, my man.

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: Naww, I'm totally sober!

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: Whaddya think... If I get infected, you think I'll get the day off tomorrow?

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Maybe. But forget tomorrow, you'll never have to go to work again.

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: Just pretend I didn't say anything... *hic*. Damn, maybe I am drunk after all.

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: Sorry, my head's starting... to spin...

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: Fine. Seems like you really are out of it, so I'll restrain myself and not beat the shit out of you.

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: Just don't ever crack a joke like that again... 'Cause if you do, you're taking a trip to the hospital to get stitches for your nose.

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: Eep... It won't happen again.

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: To be honest, I always wanted to be a knight, ever since I was a little kid.

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: Not a competition knight, mind you. Something much older... The kind my grandpa's generation really looked up to.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: You mean like those campaign knights that entered the city not too long ago?

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: Yeah, I know I don't have the skills for that... *sigh*.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Look at it this way, their way of fighting is totally outdated. What can you accomplish these days with brute strength alone?

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: Sure, nobody's arguing with that. But... We've got to fight, like it or not.

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: Phew... Boss, pour me another one!

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: If you ask me, everyone wants a better life. And the best way to do that is to get into business.

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: You want to get into the business world?

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Uh, yeah, I guess? Preferably a large corporation. The nine-to-five, cubicle sort. But y'know, being a salesman doesn't sound half-bad either. I think I'd be pretty good at it.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: I heard big companies give bonuses to outstanding employees too. What could be better than earning a stable salary?

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: Haha, when you put it like that...

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: You're too naive!

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: Working in a corporation isn't as easy as you think.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Hmm... Well, it's just a pipe dream anyway. Everyone knows it's tough getting into a good company.

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: True, it's tough, but that's still the easy part. Getting in is just the beginning.

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: The problem is, once you're in, you can't get out. That's the hard part.

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: Today, I... actually ditched work. I didn't show up.

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: I originally wanted to take some time off, but I'm out of vacation days for the year, so I didn't even bother applying.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: You were gone the whole day and nobody even bothered to call you?

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: My phone's dead. Forgot to charge it last night.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Good man.

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: Are you sure that's not going to be a problem?

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: It's a problem all right. A big problem.

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: ...Scratch what I said earlier. Maybe you're a little TOO gutsy.

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: Hah... Haha... Is this what you'd call having guts?

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: My tongue's completely numb, my stomach's empty, and my brain's faring about as well.

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: Err, no, I just drank a whole bunch, so there's alcohol in my stomach and water in my head.

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: What the hell are you on about?

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Quite the unique saying you came up with there. I like it.

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: That said, I feel pretty good now that I can't hear my ringtone... At least I can fool myself into thinking everything's fine.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: With all due respect, that feeling won't last forever.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: As soon as you charge your phone... Sheesh, I don't even want to think about it.

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: ...Then let's not. I'm starting to get the chills again.

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: Even I'm starting to feel sick to my stomach.

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: Whatever, I've made my peace with it. There's no shortage of grunts like me. You've got the more experienced old hands, and the more gung-ho young guns. No point delaying the inevitable.

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: I'm just worn out, man... I just wanna take a day off where I don't have to worry about anything.

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: If I'm really gonna get fired over this, then so be it. At least that spares me from all the agonizing over not being able to make up my mind.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: You really do have nerves of steel. You're not afraid at all?

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: ...Can't you tell I'm joking? Of course I'm afraid. I still haven't paid off my mortgage.

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: So I'm gonna head home and pull an all-nighter writing a report for the head of the department about how I was in a coma all day from a serious illness, and accidentally broke my phone.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: That... might be a bit of a stretch.

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: Just a bit.

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: Who cares if it's true or not? All that matters is having an excuse to step down.

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: Alright, that's enough for today. No more drinking.

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: Boss, give me the tab... Tch, you two sure know how to take advantage of a guy's hospitality. Picking all the expensive drinks, eh?

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: I do appreciate it. Ahh, what a rare treat, to enjoy a friend's hospitality on one of my few trips to the city.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: To show my thanks, can I offer you a suggestion?

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: What, me?

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Why don't you spend the night here at the bar? I took a look and it's going to be open all night, with plenty of customers.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: And tomorrow morning, find another place with lots of people. Try to keep your head down in the crowd.

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: Huh? What's that supposed to mean?

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: That's all I have to say. I'll be off now.

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: He's gone just like that, huh? Didn't even care to elaborate.

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: Well, I'd better get going too. What about you? Are you going to listen to him and drink all night?
Later, the old man told me that he's a Darksteel, and that I might be cut out to become a Lazurite.
He may have been as cold and shady as his rank, but I don't think there's anything particularly blue about me. Oh, not that I'm trying to argue with you, boss. Lazurite suits me just fine.
When the old man picked me up—well, I won't say that, since I was doing perfectly fine by myself and didn't need to be 'picked up.'
Basically, I had just hunted two fowlbeasts at the time. Scalded off the plumage, bled them out, and had them ready for eating after some time over the fire pit.
They came out pretty good, and the old man ate a fowlbeast and a half all by himself. Left me with two heads, a pair of claws, and one leg.
After he finished, he started talking like one of those high-and-mighty folks out of the storybooks:
Even without a teacher or any tools, you're still able to hunt these slippery fowlbeasts. They can be difficult even for experienced hunters your age. You've got a natural talent.
How about it, child? Want to live the good life?
—Of course. How could I not?

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: I must've been drunk as hell too. Ended up wasting all that time because I somehow believed what he said.

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: The sun's almost up... Better start heading back.

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: Ugh... It's so cold.

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: So this is what Kawalerielki looks like at this hour. There's hardly anyone around, the trash everywhere hasn't been cleaned up yet, and there are discarded knight posters all over the ground.

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: Hah, people are all trash...

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: —Who's there?!

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: You people are...

steps.name: Armorless Union Assassin
steps.text: Ironwrist Knight.

steps.name: Armorless Union Assassin
steps.text: By refusing to cooperate with the General Chamber, you've impeded the path for others.

steps.name: Armorless Union Assassin
steps.text: The Blood Knight can no longer protect you.
This whole deal with pawning my life off to them... The more time passes, the more I see things clearly.

The knights are commodities they hoard inside their warehouses. The assassins are weapons they wield. And what of public opinion? It's their best tool for manipulation, and they've studied it thoroughly.
Money and power. In Kazimierz, these two things are often inextricably linked.
Hey, I'm not saying you have to become a tycoon or anything, but look, if you want to live a better life, you have to rub shoulders with those people.
Most people are fine climbing over others, one rung at a time. But when will you ever be free from someone else's control?
So just don't think about it too much. If you're privileged enough, just try to live a better, more comfortable life.

At least now, I won't be asked to take someone's life over the phone anymore. If something goes wrong, getting hurt is the least of our worries. We'll need a good excuse to pull the wool over the boss's eyes, right?

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: Alright, you can open your eyes now. You look fine.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: ...Nngh...

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: If you keep stroking your face like that, I'm going to make you need another one.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Egads, Monique. I shudder at the thought.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Having bandages all over my face is... Hmm, how should I put this, new and exciting?

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: Donna. Donna Tyrell. And you're Joel Tyrell.

steps.name: Donna
steps.text: You'd better not mess it up again after the doctor comes back.

steps.name: Joel
steps.text: Oh right, our titles have changed too. We're husband and wife now, right?

steps.name: Joel
steps.text: Oh, are you blushing?

steps.name: Donna
steps.text: Did they carve out your eyeballs?

steps.name: Joel
steps.text: No need to be so hostile. While this arrangement might be a bit... Mm, well, it's fine.

steps.name: Joel
steps.text: Oh, and don't worry, you're just as easy on the eyes as before.

steps.name: Donna
steps.text: ...So they definitely carved out your eyeballs.

steps.name: A Doctor
steps.text: I see you're awake now. How are you doing?

steps.name: A Doctor
steps.text: You chose to go with the accelerated program. Though Originium Arts can speed up the process so you won't need multiple surgeries, there are still corresponding risks.

steps.name: A Doctor
steps.text: You won't be able to remove the bandages for a while, and I'd suggest returning for a follow-up once a month to ensure the most stable results.

steps.name: Joel
steps.text: Thank you. I feel great already.

steps.name: Joel
steps.text: But I don't think the follow-ups will be necessary.

steps.name: A Doctor
steps.text: Urk...

steps.name: Joel
steps.text: We'll figure something out on our own. Thank you for your hard work, doctor.

steps.name: Donna
steps.text: That was sudden. You're gonna have to figure out how to get rid of the body on your own.

steps.name: Joel
steps.text: I didn't have a choice. Nobody can be allowed to know about this. I could've chosen my words better, but I meant what I said.

steps.name: Joel
steps.text: Dead men tell no tales.

steps.name: Joel
steps.text: By the way, did you hear about what the General Chamber did to a group of Infected knights who had been following the Blood Knight?

steps.name: Joel
steps.text: I ran into one of 'em last night, just to make sure.

steps.name: Donna
steps.text: I've heard a thing or two. But it's none of my business.

steps.name: Donna
steps.text: And I suggest you keep your shiny new nose out of it too. Don't forget, we've got nothing to do with the Armorless Union now.

steps.name: Joel
steps.text: Heh, I suppose you're right.

steps.name: Joel
steps.text: It's none of our business now.

steps.name: Joel
steps.text: Alright, then we're about to start a brand new chapter of our lives. What's the plan? If we're going to sell stuff... are we really going to run a business?

steps.name: Donna
steps.text: Even if you wanted to, Darksteel would never let you.

steps.name: Donna
steps.text: It'd already be a miracle if you didn't scare off all our customers.

steps.name: Joel
steps.text: Please, do I even have the talent to mess anything up? We have everything we could ever want now, but I still need something to kill the time.

steps.name: Donna
steps.text: You've got time to kill?

steps.name: Joel
steps.text: Kind of. You in the mood to go hunting, just the two of us? We can go buy a villa out in the countryside. I'll teach you how to hunt fowlbeasts—nobody's better than me.

steps.name: Joel
steps.text: Ha, hunting for sport. Never could've imagined that back when I was scraping by in the woods.

steps.name: Joel
steps.text: I've simply never had the free time. But now I've got nothing BUT free time, so I might as well treat myself.

steps.name: Donna
steps.text: Seems like all that free time fried your brain then. You can go by yourself.

steps.name: Donna
steps.text: I'm going on vacation, preferably some place nice like Dossoles or Siesta. You won't catch me dead in the boonies.

steps.name: Donna
steps.text: Seriously, after all the work it took to make this day possible, you're just reminiscing about your childhood?

steps.name: Donna
steps.text: What are you planning?

steps.name: Joel
steps.text: ...Honestly, who knows?

steps.name: Joel
steps.text: If I can live a better life, I'll try to do exactly that. No need to sweat the details.

steps.name: Donna
steps.text: ...If your brain malfunctions and you decide to go live in a cave or whatever, you might as well transfer all your assets to me first. I'll send you my bank account number when we get back.

steps.name: Joel
steps.text: Haha, if something happens to me, you'd inherit everything I own anyway, just from our legal status.

steps.name: Donna
steps.text: Good point. Might as well speed up the process then.

steps.name: Joel
steps.text: How cruel. Anyway, enough of that. After I tie up some loose ends, how about we go on that vacation I suggested? Give it a thought, alright?

steps.name: Joel
steps.text: Wherever you decide to go, why not make it a team effort?
